title: Quoting vs Globbing
description:
By default, the shell expands glob patterns before running a command.

But if you use quotes, the pattern is treated as literal text instead.

Examples:
- `ls *.txt` expands and lists matching files
- `ls "*.txt"` does NOT expand, it looks for a file literally named *.txt

This is very important when working with special characters.
